assertions.assertion: The denial was issued under reason code PR-204
CPT 93226 represents a 48-hour Holter monitoring study
The payer letter states the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The clinical indication documents a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation and cardiac arrhythmia
The diagnosis codes for the atrial fibrillation and cardiac arrhythmia are I48.91 and I49.9
The patient has persistent episodes of palpitations that interfere with daily activities
The diagnosis code for palpitations is R00.2
A 48-hour Holter monitor was ordered for continuous ambulatory electrocardiographic recording
The purpose of the monitoring was to further characterize the arrhythmia burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances
